name: PDF Toolkit
tagline: A fast, offline, open-source PDF toolkit — merge, split, compress, convert, protect, watermark and more.
description: PDF Toolkit is a local, offline desktop app for everyday PDF work: merge and split, extract/delete/reorder/rotate pages, compress and web-optimize, convert images to PDF and PDF to images or text, password-protect and set permissions, add text or image watermarks and page numbers, edit or strip metadata, redact, compare, and repair — plus batch processing for all of it. 100% open source, built on permissive libraries (pypdf, pikepdf, pypdfium2, Pillow, reportlab); nothing is uploaded anywhere.
aiStack: Python (tkinter GUI + CLI), pypdf, pikepdf/qpdf, pypdfium2, Pillow, reportlab
